scientific_integrity: Exact rational polygon area computation, an exhaustive base-width incidence certificate, and the Ehrhart argument establish the unrestricted parametrized theorem; no finite interpolation substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: The rational interval is a proven lower bound, not the optimal rational endpoint; the exact census is for positive multiples of six. Potential unindexed earlier weighted-root incidence work has not been excluded.
title: An asymmetric six-direction rational arrangement with Chern-slope limit \(197/81\)
